notes.tooltip: What the canvas does not fully show
notes.notDiagram: There is nothing in this code the canvas can draw.
notes.outsideCode: Code before or after the diagram is kept as written.
notes.wrapper: The code around the diagram, such as a figure, is kept as written.
notes.diagramSetting: The diagram setting {{detail}} is kept in the code.
notes.edgeOption: The {{detail}} edge option is kept in the code.
notes.scripted: Scripted diagram content, such as loops, is kept in the code.
notes.mathMode: Math-mode diagram content is kept in the code.
notes.unplacedNode: Nodes without a fixed position are kept in the code.
notes.unreadEdge: Edges the canvas cannot read are kept in the code.
notes.danglingEdge: Edges that do not connect two nodes are kept in the code.
notes.gridCoordinates: Grid coordinates are shown at fixed positions.
notes.formattedLabels: Formatted labels are shown as plain text.
notes.unknownShapes: Shapes the canvas does not have are shown as rectangles.
notes.estimatedSize: Nodes without a width and height are shown at an estimated size.
notes.colorAdjustments: Adjusted colors, such as lighten, are shown with their base color.
notes.colorExpressions: Colors set by variables or expressions are not shown on the canvas.
notes.strokeStyles: Some line styles are shown with the nearest canvas style.
notes.arrowMarks: Arrow marks the canvas does not have are shown as plain arrows.
notes.freePoints: Edges through free points are drawn straight on the canvas.
notes.tikzCommand: The {{detail}} command is not drawn. A canvas edit rewrites the code without it.
notes.truncated: The code is too long, so only its first part is drawn.
notes.mermaidNotFlowchart: Only flowcharts can be drawn on the canvas. This code is a {{detail}} diagram.
notes.mermaidFrontmatter: The frontmatter block is kept in the code.
notes.mermaidDirective: Config directives are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidComment: Comments are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidAccessibility: Accessibility titles and descriptions are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidClick: Click handlers are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidStyleProperty: The {{detail}} style property is kept in the code.
notes.mermaidClassProperty: The {{detail}} class property is kept in the code.
notes.mermaidLinkStyleProperty: The {{detail}} link style property is kept in the code.
notes.mermaidNodeSetting: The {{detail}} node setting is kept in the code.
notes.mermaidEdgeSetting: The {{detail}} edge setting is kept in the code.
notes.mermaidInvisibleLink: Invisible links are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidLinkLength: Link lengths are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidSubgraphDirection: Subgraph directions are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidUnknownStatement: Statements the canvas cannot read are kept in the code.
notes.mermaidShape: The {{detail}} shape is shown as the closest canvas shape.
notes.mermaidThickLink: Thick links are shown as normal lines.
notes.mermaidArrowHead: Circle and cross arrow heads are shown as arrows.
notes.mermaidMarkdownLabel: Markdown labels are shown as plain text.
notes.mermaidNoFlowchartHeader: Only flowcharts can be drawn on the canvas. Start the code with flowchart or graph.
